model/configs/stage0.yaml.text:
# Numerical sampling choices, not medical policy. Research owns signal/effect/rule values.
# Provisional conventions not specified numerically in the research YAML, listed in report.
sampling:
  background_interval_hours: 1
  event_interval_hours: 0.25
  # Last sample remains strictly inside each day; interval truncation < one ULP.
  boundary: nextafter_24
profile:
  label: Mars-class deep-space transit — simulated
  # Bounds are illustrative pending source verification (research A12).
  comms_one_way_delay_min: {min: 0, max: 20}
  blackouts: []
  spe_event_timing_source: DONKI SEP 2017-09-10, observed near Earth; synthetic mission-day mapping
s2_shape:
  ramp_days: 2
  recovery_days: 2
radiation:
  caution_watch_msv_h: 0.1
  shelter_act_msv_h: 0.5
  placeholder: true
sleep:
  policy_source: research/rules.yaml

research/cards.yaml.text:
# Action cards (Discussion §2.4 template) — DRAFT v0.1 · Owner: Claude · MUST be verified by Narayan/B before demo
# Rendered verbatim by the dashboard. No diagnoses. Procedural steps point to mission-approved procedures; we do not invent medical treatment.
# Mission profile: Mars-class transit (D10) — ground replies may take up to ~40 min round trip or be unavailable in blackout.

cards:
  - id: physiological-change
    status: watch
    heading: Physiological change
    why: "{signals} have moved away from your preflight normal for {days} nights in a row."
    uncertainty: "These changes are nonspecific. Poor sleep, hard exercise, stress or illness can all cause them. This is not a diagnosis."
    do_now:
      - "Check that your wearable was worn and fitted correctly last night."
      - "Complete today's symptom check-in."
    recheck: "Tomorrow's overnight readings and check-in."
    onboard_escalation: "Tell the onboard CMO if you have symptoms or if this continues for another night."
    ground_escalation: "Optional: queue a note for the flight surgeon; replies may be delayed."
    source_ids: [Li2017, Mishra2020, Alavi2022]
    assumption_ids: [A2, A6, A7]

  - id: physiological-change-act
    status: act
    heading: Physiological change — check symptoms
    why: "{signals} have shifted strongly or together with reported symptoms ({symptoms})."
    uncertainty: "The pattern can occur with illness but does not confirm one."
    do_now:
      - "Follow the mission-approved symptom assessment procedure."
      - "Contact the onboard CMO today."
    recheck: "As directed by the CMO or the approved procedure."
    onboard_escalation: "Contact the onboard CMO now."
    ground_escalation: "CMO decides whether to message the flight surgeon; message is queued if the link is down."
    source_ids: [Mishra2020, Alavi2022]
    assumption_ids: [A2, A7]

  - id: symptom-escalation
    status: act
    heading: Symptom needs attention
    why: "You reported {symptoms}."
    uncertainty: "SpaceHealth cannot assess this symptom. A person must."
    do_now:
      - "Contact the onboard CMO now."
      - "Follow the mission-approved procedure for this symptom."
    recheck: "As directed by the CMO."
    onboard_escalation: "Contact the onboard CMO now."
    ground_escalation: "CMO decides; queued if the link is down."
    source_ids: []
    assumption_ids: [A7]

  - id: sleep-short
    status: watch
    heading: Sleep shorter than your normal
    why: "You slept {hours} h, below your usual range, for {nights} nights."
    uncertainty: "Sleep estimates from a wrist device can be off. This does not measure how alert you are."
    do_now:
      - "Plan a protected sleep opportunity tonight if the schedule allows."
      - "Consider extra cross-checks on safety-critical tasks today."
    recheck: "Tomorrow's sleep estimate."
    onboard_escalation: "Tell the onboard CMO if you feel impaired or this continues."
    ground_escalation: "Optional: queue a schedule note for ground planners."
    source_ids: [FlynnEvans2016, Barger2014]
    assumption_ids: [A7]

  - id: sleep-debt
    status: act
    heading: Sleep debt building up
    why: "Over the last 7 nights you slept {debt_h} h less than your preflight normal — about one full night of lost sleep."
    uncertainty: "In sleep-restriction studies, alertness kept falling with accumulated sleep loss while people felt only slightly sleepier. How you feel may underestimate the effect."
    do_now:
      - "Tell the onboard CMO and the commander before starting safety-critical tasks."
      - "Arrange a protected recovery sleep opportunity as soon as the schedule allows."
    recheck: "After the next sleep period."
    onboard_escalation: "Tell the onboard CMO today."
    ground_escalation: "Queue a schedule note for ground planners."
    source_ids: [VanDongen2003, Belenky2003, NASA-HRP-Sleep2016]
    assumption_ids: [A7]

  - id: radiation-spe-procedure
    status: act
    heading: Solar particle event warning
    why: "A space-weather warning is active{rate_text}."
    uncertainty: "Dose so far today is {dose_today} mSv{partial_text}."
    do_now:
      - "Follow the mission's approved solar particle event procedure now, including moving to the designated shelter if the procedure says so."
      - "Keep your personal dosimeter on."
    recheck: "When the all-clear is given."
    onboard_escalation: "Confirm with the crew/commander that everyone is following the procedure."
    ground_escalation: "Log for ground; the procedure does not wait for a reply."
    source_ids: [NASA-STD-3001-V1C, OCHMO-TB-020]
    assumption_ids: [A8]

  - id: radiation-budget
    status: watch
    heading: Radiation budget
    why: "Mission dose {mission_dose} mSv{career_text} — {pct}% of the 600 mSv career limit."
    uncertainty: "{career_unknown_text}Background rate measured on the way to Mars was about 1.84 mSv/day."
    do_now:
      - "Review upcoming activities that add dose with the crew."
    recheck: "Weekly."
    onboard_escalation: "Discuss with the commander/CMO if planned activities would exceed the mission plan."
    ground_escalation: "Queue a budget summary for ground."
    source_ids: [NASA-STD-3001-V1C, Zeitlin2013]
    assumption_ids: [A8]

research/rules.yaml.text:
# Module detection rules (Discussion §2.3) — DRAFT v0.1 · Owner: Claude · Verify: Narayan/B · Implement: Codex
# These are the M1 default rules. Model experiments may change numbers; every change is logged in model/EXPERIMENT_LOG.md and DECISIONS.md.

baseline:   # Discussion §1.4
  window: preflight days -14..-1, fixed for the whole mission (no rolling update in v1)
  center: median(valid preflight values)
  scale: max(1.4826 * MAD, signals.yaml min_scale)
  min_valid_days: 10          # A6 engineering assumption; Alavi2022 Ext. Data: baseline stable after ~7 nights for >80% (supports)
  insufficient: "fewer than min_valid_days ⇒ that signal is 'insufficient'"
  no_future_data: "evaluation on day d uses only data from days ≤ d"

physiological_change:
  signals: {rhr_bpm: up, hrv_rmssd_ms: down, skin_temp_delta_c: up}
  shifted_day: "signal z beyond ±2.0 in its direction"                  # A7
  watch: "≥2 signals shifted on each of 2 consecutive days"              # A7
  act:
    - "watch AND any red-flag symptom today"
    - "≥2 signals with z beyond ±3.0 on 2 consecutive days"             # A7
  symptom_only:
    red_flag: [fever, shortness_of_breath, chest_pain, fainting, vision_change]   # NEEDS B REVIEW
    rule: "red-flag symptom ⇒ act regardless of signals (card: symptom-escalation); other symptoms with no signal shift ⇒ nominal + 'symptoms logged' note"
  unknown: "fewer than 2 of the 3 signals evaluable today (missing or insufficient baseline)"
  correlated_note: "rhr and hrv come from the same wearable — reason text must not present them as independent confirmations"
  forbidden_words: ["infection detected", "you have", "diagnosis", "diagnosed"]
  heading_watch: "Physiological change"
  heading_act: "Physiological change — check symptoms"

sleep_alertness:
  signals: {sleep_hours: down}
  watch: "sleep_hours z ≤ -2.0 on 2 consecutive nights"                 # A7
  act: "sum over the last 7 nights of max(0, baseline_sleep_hours - sleep_hours) >= 8.16 h  (extra wakefulness vs own preflight normal ≈ one night of total sleep deprivation). Missing nights are not counted as 0 debt: if <5 of 7 nights valid, act cannot be evaluated (stay watch/unknown)."   # GROUNDED magnitude: VanDongen2003 (lapses ~linear in cumulative wake >15.84 h/day; 24-15.84 = 8.16 h); relative-to-baseline application = R3 (Narayan)
  context_absolute_debt: "also compute Van Dongen absolute excess wakefulness sum(max(0, 8.16 - sleep_hours)) over 7 nights; show as information only, never as a status"
  unknown: "sleep_hours missing today or insufficient baseline"

radiation:
  not_baseline_based: true
  act_warning: "any spe_warning=true sample ⇒ act immediately for that crew/day (card radiation-spe-procedure); stays act until warning cleared + 1 day"
  rate_tiers:   # STRUCTURE grounded (NASA Artemis II two-tier caution/shelter; HERA seminar). NUMBERS NOT PUBLIC → mission-configurable placeholders, labelled as such in UI
    caution_watch_msv_h: "placeholder (configurable)"
    shelter_act_msv_h: "placeholder (configurable)"
  watch_budget: "prior_career (if known) + mission dose so far + remaining_days × background ≥ 600 mSv"   # GROUNDED: [V1 4030]; Zeitlin2013; Hassler2014
  integration: "trapezoid between consecutive time-stamped samples within the day; dose_coverage = covered hours / 24"   # A8
  career_unknown: "if prior_career_dose_msv is null, show 'career total unknown — mission dose only'"
  never: "250 mSv is a vehicle design requirement [V1 4031], NOT an alert trigger"

card_cap:
  routine_max: 3
  never_capped: ["any act from radiation", "red-flag symptom act"]

research/scenarios.yaml.text:
# v1 scenario set (Discussion §2.2) — DRAFT v0.1 · Owner: Claude · Verify: Narayan/B
# All effect sizes are SIMULATION ASSUMPTIONS (A2, A11) unless a source is given.
# onset / symptom / detection / recovery are separate fields; a symptom day does not prove an infection existed earlier.
mission: {profile: mars_transit_v1, crew: [C1, C2, C3, C4], preflight_days: [-14, -1], mission_days: [1, 180]}

scenarios:
  S1:
    required: true
    what: quiet mission, normal noise only, all 4 crew
    truth: {moduleId: null, onsetDay: null}
    pass: "no act without a defined cause; REPORT routine false alerts per 100 evaluable crew-days (no fixed threshold — target set by Narayan after toy run)"
  S2:
    required: true
    crew: C2
    moduleId: physiological_change
    onsetDay: 40
    symptomDay: 42
    endDay: 48
    effects:   # ramp in over 2 days, hold, recover by day 48
      rhr_bpm: "+5.6 bpm (dev); holdout per-person U(3.1, 8.6)"       # GROUNDED: Mishra2020 Supp. Table 14 (grounding.md §1)
      hrv_rmssd_ms: "-0.5 to -1.0 x own preflight SD"                 # DIRECTION-GROUNDED: Natarajan2020, Mason2022
      skin_temp_delta_c: "+0.5 to +1.0 x own preflight SD (nightly)"  # DIRECTION-GROUNDED: Mason2022, Smarr2020
      symptoms_from_42: [sore_throat, fatigue]
    pass: "watch or act by day 42; evidence lists the shifted signals with directions; text contains no diagnosis ('infection detected' forbidden)"
  S3:
    required: true
    crew: all
    moduleId: radiation
    onsetDay: 72
    timeline: "spe_warning=true at t=06:00 day 72; dose-rate rises over ~2 h, peaks, decays over ~24–36 h; multiple onsets allowed (DONKI Sep-2017 clustering)"
    event_total_dose_msv: "19.5 mSv over ~9 days, front-loaded (dev). GROUNDED: Zeitlin2013 Table 1, Mar 7-15 2012. Holdout x0.2 / x1 / x5"
    shelter_effect: "assumption: sheltered crew dose rate reduced; only if card 'done' recorded — v1 does NOT model it (keep simple)"
    pass: "radiation act at the first warning sample (same day, before end-of-day); daily and cumulative doses equal independent integration within 1e-6; dose_coverage<1 shown as partial"
  S4:
    required: true
    crew: C3
    moduleId: sleep_alertness
    onsetDay: 95
    endDay: 101
    effects: {sleep_hours: "5.0-5.4 h for 7 nights"}  # GROUNDED: FlynnEvans2016 misaligned 5.4 h; NASA Sleep Evidence Report 2016
    pass: "watch by day 97; any act requires a documented rule using available inputs (no PVT in v1 ⇒ no act from sleep alone)"
  N1:
    required: true
    crew: C1
    what: "isolated RHR rises (+5 to +10 bpm, single days 60, 61, 110) with no other signal change and no symptoms"  # GROUNDED magnitude: Quer2020 (20% have a week with >=10 bpm swing)
    pass: "no act; no physiological watch from one signal alone; never infection wording"
  N2:
    required: true
    crew: C4
    what: "(a) only 8 valid preflight days for hrv; (b) wearable gap days 120–124 (rhr/hrv/temp null); (c) check-in skipped days 130–131"
    pass: "unknown where data insufficient/missing; never nominal on missing; no crash; skipped check-in ≠ 'no symptoms'"
later:
  S5: "slow mood decline — ordinal trend rule, not z-score"
  S6: "missed exercise — adherence notice, not bone loss"

research/signals.yaml.text:
# Signal contract table (Discussion §2.1) — research view
# Owner: Claude (draft) · Verify: Narayan/B · Status: DRAFT v0.1 (Sat 2026-11-14)
# label: evidence-backed | engineering assumption | unverified
# sim_* fields are SIMULATION inputs only (realistic fake data). Detection never uses population ranges (except M0 comparator).
# plausible_* = physical plausibility; outside → model marks dataQuality "suspect" (contract v0.1.1).

signals:
  rhr_bpm:
    unit: bpm
    v1: required
    meaning: nightly resting heart rate (overnight average)
    sim_person_baseline_range: [48, 68]        # per-crewmember preflight median
    sim_day_to_day_sd: 1.5                      # within-person nightly noise
    label: engineering assumption
    support: "Alavi2022 Ext. Data: median overnight-RHR range over 3 months ≈ 3 bpm; SD of medians 0.8 (civilians). Supports small within-person noise."
    plausible: [25, 200]
    min_scale: 1.5                              # A6 — floor on robust scale
  hrv_rmssd_ms:
    unit: ms
    v1: required
    meaning: nightly RMSSD
    sim_person_baseline_range: [30, 90]
    sim_day_to_day_cv: 0.15
    label: engineering assumption
    support: "None verified; large inter-individual spread is general physiology knowledge (unverified)."
    plausible: [3, 300]
    min_scale: 5
    missing_rule: "may be missing; never replaced by 0"
  skin_temp_delta_c:
    unit: degC deviation from personal reference
    v1: required
    sim_person_baseline: 0.0
    sim_day_to_day_sd: 0.15
    label: engineering assumption
    support: "Li2017 uses skin temperature as a wearable signal; magnitude not yet verified."
    plausible: [-3, 3]
    min_scale: 0.1
  sleep_hours:
    unit: h
    v1: required
    sim_person_baseline_range: [6.0, 7.2]
    sim_day_to_day_sd: 0.6
    label: evidence-backed (range) / engineering assumption (noise)
    support: "FlynnEvans2016: ISS mean sleep 6.4 ± 1.2 h (aligned) vs 5.4 ± 1.4 h (misaligned) by actigraphy, n=21. Barger2014: in-flight sleep ≈ 6 h (verify exact figure in text)."
    plausible: [0, 16]
    min_scale: 0.3
  symptoms:
    type: Symptom[] (contract enum)
    v1: required
    z_scored: false
    rule: "categorical; [] with checkin_completed=true means reported none"
  spe_warning:
    type: boolean (RadiationEvent)
    v1: required
    z_scored: false
    support: "OCHMO-TB-020: SPE alerting so crew can seek shelter. Timing realism from DONKI SEP events (observed near Earth)."
  dose_rate_msv_h:
    unit: mSv/h (RadiationEvent sample)
    v1: required for storm event
    sim_background: "1.84/24 ≈ 0.077 mSv/h (Mars cruise GCR)"
    label: evidence-backed
    support: "Zeitlin2013: cruise GCR dose-equivalent 1.84 ± 0.33 mSv/day."
  daily_dose_msv:
    unit: mSv/day
    v1: required
    derived: "integral of dose_rate samples over the day (A8); cumulative = sum of daily"
    sim_background: 1.84
    label: evidence-backed
    support: "Zeitlin2013 (cruise); NASA-STD-3001 V1C p.45–46 design rate <1.3 mSv/day shielded, ≈1.5 unshielded (solar min). Use 1.84 measured; note vehicle-dependence."
  prior_career_dose_msv:
    unit: mSv
    v1: optional context
    rule: "null = unknown; never assumed 0"
    career_limit: 600   # evidence-backed, NASA-STD-3001 V1C [V1 4030] p.40
  pvt_mean_rt_ms: {unit: ms, v1: optional, label: unverified, note: "PVT-inspired browser test, not a validated instrument"}
  pvt_lapses: {unit: count, v1: optional, label: evidence-backed definition, support: "Basner2011: PVT-B lapse = RT > 355 ms"}
  mood_1to5: {unit: ordinal, v1: optional, z_scored: false}
  stress_1to5: {unit: ordinal, v1: optional, z_scored: false}
  exercise_minutes: {unit: min/day, v1: later}
  co2_ppm: {unit: ppm, v1: later}

renamed_from_old_docs: {rhr: rhr_bpm, hrv_rmssd: hrv_rmssd_ms, skin_temp_delta: skin_temp_delta_c, sleep_h: sleep_hours, pvt_rt_ms: pvt_mean_rt_ms, dose_msv: daily_dose_msv, mood: mood_1to5, stress: stress_1to5, exercise_min: exercise_minutes}
